case_name: Pipeline Dent Fatigue Verification Method Cross-Check

regulatory_context.document: Safety Advisory SA 2025-01 - Evaluation of Dents in Pipe
regulatory_context.issue: Potentially overestimated fatigue life predictions and non-conservatism associated with API RP 1183 First Edition Table 6.

cer_referenced_research.author: X. K. Zhu
cer_referenced_research.title: A verification study of fatigue-based methods in API RP 1183 for estimating fatigue life of pipeline dents
cer_referenced_research.journal: International Journal of Pressure Vessels and Piping

benchmark_source.title: Comparison of Fatigue Models in API 1183 for Predicting Fatigue Life of Pipeline Dents
benchmark_source.author: Xian-Kui Zhu

source.note: CER SA 2025-01 provides the regulatory context and identifies non-conservatism concerns with API RP 1183 Table 6. The numerical benchmark values used in this case are taken from the public SRNL engineering paper SRNL-STI-2023-00088, Section 3.2. The CER advisory itself is not the source of the 150, >308, 130, and 214 year values.
